events.title: Demo Update 0.9.3 - Blueprints and QOL
events.summary: Hey all,The demo has just been updated again with the following:New ContentA blueprint system has been adding, making duplicating areas of the factory easier. Blueprints by default get deleted at the end of a run, but you can save them to the global list, allowing you to load them in during subsequent runs.QOLTooltips have had a pass done. events.title: Demo Update 0.9.2 - Gas and Pipes
events.summary: Hey all,The demo has just been updated again with the following:New Content12 new buildings have been added to the demo.Pipes have been added. These attach to any building they are connected to, and automatically move liquids or gases throughout all pipes connected. Pipes bends, vats and junctions have also been added. 30 new upgrades have been added.Several weapons have been reworked to make combat feel better.Several weapons now have an upgrade chain of weapons.
